'''Quarlo I'Shibix''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] working for [[Mon Tondievz, Ltd.]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krann]]. He also operated an [[eldratz]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] ring. I'Shibix made most of his profits from the [[Spice/Legends|spice]], but he also used it to keep enslaved [[Kluuzot]] workers in line as they mined [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] for him. After the effects of the spice got to be too incapacitating for a worker, I'Shibix released the Kluuzot.
